title: 别墅
cue:
Describe your idea of an ideal house (理想的别墅).
You should say：
what kind of house it would be
why you would like to live there
what special features it would have
and explain whether you think you will ever live in a house like this.
a:
这个话题要求你谈的是“理想的别墅”，所以你可以向考官尽情地展示你会用虚拟语气这种貌似高深、其实没什么难度的句式 ☺

My ideal house would be just an average house, nothing too fancy.

It would be close to public transport and have two or three cosy bedrooms, a spacious and bright living room, a nice kitchen, some bathrooms and a garage. Most importantly, it must have a garden. I would love to watch my plants grow.

There should be plenty of appliances in the kitchen, like a gas stove, a fridge and a dishwasher. And there would be a dining area next to the kitchen, with a dining table and some chairs.

The living room would have a high ceiling, large windows, a sofa, a coffee table, a flat-screen TV and some paintings on the walls.

In the bathroom, there must be a bathtub where I could relax in warm water after a busy day. By the way, the garage would be for my car, bicycle and tools.

Such a house would cost a fortune in my city. So I guess it’s nothing more than just a dream for me…
vocab: 普通的（在这里它不是“平均”的意思）
舒适的卧室（cosy“舒适的”，英国人用它来形容房间或者家具）
吸尘器（英国生活里常直接称为 vacuum）
微波炉（英国生活里常直接称为 microwave）
浴缸（生活里常会直接说 tub）
要花非常多的钱，要花一大笔钱
硬木地板（flooring 是指地板的材料）
一栋只含一户的别墅，独栋别墅
一栋含有左右两户的别墅
一栋含三户或以上的别墅，联排别墅
